description: How finance, the travel program, and traveling employees relate to each other: who books through whom, who submits and approves spend, how cards and reimbursements settle, and which reporting loops keep spend visible.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Booking travel through the managed program

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Submitting, approving, and correcting spend day to day

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Corporate cards, reimbursements, and spend settlement

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Policy guardrails, budgets, and spend reporting

relations.name: Submits expenses for approval
relations.description: Captures receipts and submits expense claims that flow through policy checks and approval chains into finance's ledger.

relations.name: Reimburses approved expenses
relations.description: Pays out approved out-of-pocket claims in the next reimbursement run and posts the spend to the right cost centers at close.

relations.name: Issues corporate cards for travel spend
relations.description: Issues corporate cards that fund employee travel purchases, with card transactions flowing back for automatic reconciliation against claims.

relations.name: Books trips through the managed channel
relations.description: Books flights, hotels, and ground transport through the travel program's approved channels and negotiated rates instead of open-market sites.

relations.name: Approves and supports trips before spend
relations.description: Runs pre-trip approval, applies policy at booking time, and supports travelers with changes and disruptions before cost is locked in.

relations.name: Sets budgets and policy guardrails
relations.description: Defines the T&E policy, per-category limits, and travel budgets that the travel manager encodes into booking and approval rules.

relations.name: Reports committed travel spend
relations.description: Feeds booked-but-not-yet-expensed travel commitments and program leakage analysis to finance for forecasting and accrual accuracy.

relations.name: Flags out-of-policy claims for correction
relations.description: Routes policy exceptions and audit findings back to employees for justification or correction instead of finance manually policing every claim.
